newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.3889/3.3927 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.3889/3.3927 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3850 to 3.3925 pounds bid and from 3.3870 to 3.3950 offered in the interbank market on Monday.
A survey of five actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3889 pounds bid and 3.3927 offered. The averages compared with 3.3874 bid and 3.3910 pounds offered on Sunday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.390934 and 3.396012 sell.
